grow.title: Industrial companies grow faster
grow.slide1Desc: Sales, production, and finance each plan separately with different numbers and priorities.
grow.slide2Desc: No single owner of the end-to-end process, too many approvals, unclear accountability
grow.slide3Desc: Calls, chats, and urgent fixes replace structured meetings and clear planning
grow.slide4Desc: Warehouses overflow, production lags, and no one can clearly answer why.
grow.slide5Desc: Knowledge lives in spreadsheets or "key employees," not in a transparent workflow.
grow.slide6Desc: When plans fail, it takes days to understand what went wrong and who is responsible.

solution.title: Yes, but in order to streamline this complexity, you'll need more than processes
solution.card1Title: You'll need a system tailored to your reality
solution.card1Desc: Not a copy-paste of what works at a global HQ or in textbooks
solution.card2Title: You'll need someone who understands both finance and operations
solution.card2Desc: Someone who can translate the language of P&L and budgets into executable supply chain strategies
solution.card3Title: You'll need a real process owner
solution.card3Desc: You need a real process owner to ensure accountability and execution

services.title: IBP consulting
services.subtitle: I design and implement planning systems (S&OP, IBP) that align demand, production, and procurement with financial goals
services.service1Desc: Align operations with your business goals and growth ambitions.
services.service2Desc: Assess your current supply chain capabilities, identify gaps, and create a practical roadmap to close them.
services.service3Desc: Build monthly planning cycles that actually work across functions and support the journey to the strategic target.
services.service4Desc: Prepare your processes, data, and teams for ERP/IBP implementation before technology deployment.
services.service5Desc: Facilitate leadership alignment to build one version of the plan and make faster, cross-functional decisions.

results.title: Tangible results
results.subtitle: Results like these don't happen overnight.They start with a clear diagnostic and a roadmap that fits your reality.
results.result1Desc: Unlock working capital through cost optimization and operational efficiency improvements.
results.result2Desc: Raise service levels from 60% to 98% and cut lead times in half through aligned planning.
results.result3Desc: Reduce inventory up to 50% without disrupting production or customer commitments.
results.result4Desc: Connect operations and finance through integrated systems (SAP IBP, Power BI) for faster decisions.

whyMe.title: Why work with me?
whyMe.reason1Desc: Led ERP and IBP transformations across Europe and the Middle East. Successfully adapted to different company cultures and operational realities.
whyMe.reason2Title: I speak the language of CFOs, Supply chain professionals, planners, and IT teams
whyMe.reason2Desc: Started in finance, so I understand budgets, P&L, and numbers. But I also know how those numbers are formed inside daily operations. That's why I can align strategy, finance, and execution around shared goals.
whyMe.reason3Title: Not just me — a team behind every project
whyMe.reason3Desc: I lead a small team of analysts, planners, and technical experts who support each project. They handle diagnostics, process mapping, Excel, Power BI, and SAP implementation. This lets me focus on strategy while they execute the changes.
whyMe.reason4Desc: I didn't manage systems designed at headquarters. I built them from scratch, side by side with teams who trusted me. That's why I know what truly works in practice, not just in theory.
whyMe.reason5Desc: I don't fit the "Big 3" consulting mold. I work where decisions happen fast, in the same meeting, not next quarter. I value clarity, accountability, and results over slides and buzzwords.
whyMe.reason6Desc: I go beyond recommendations. I create working models, Excel and Power Query tools, and ERP prototypes. This makes transformation tangible and usable from day one.

ideal.title: You'll get the most value
ideal.case1Title: Growth is outpacing your planning capabilities
ideal.case1Desc: You're expanding to new markets or scaling production,but planning, procurement, and operations can't keep up.
ideal.case2Desc: Sales, production, and finance each have their own plans —and no one really knows which numbers are right
ideal.case3Desc: You spend time fixing urgent issues instead of improving how the business runs. You want predictability, not crisis management.
ideal.case4Title: Leadership is ready to drive real change
ideal.case4Desc: The project sponsor is an owner, CEO, or COO —someone with authority to make and sustain real changes.
ideal.case5Title: Chaos is a symptom, not your culture
ideal.case5Desc: You recognize that constant phone calls, manual planning, and mismatched spreadsheets aren't a sign of hard work — they're a sign to fix the system
